title: Lara Mini Base: Language Diversity as a Resource, Not a Trade-off
abstract: arXiv:2611.16956v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: General-purpose language models are trained mostly on English: over open models we review, at most, non-English pretraining data makes up only a 12% share. Models built for European languages give them far more, but score well below general-purpose models of the same size. A common concern is that, in small models, languages compete for capacity. We present Lara Mini base, a model trained from scratch on 6T tokens in English and 44 other languages, which together cover all 24 official languages of the European Union. As training progresses, the 44 other languages together come to outweigh English. To give these languages enough capacity at low cost, Lara Mini base uses a mixture of experts architecture with 7.2B total and 0.6B active parameters. Among open base models with up to 2B active parameters, it achieves the highest average score across standard English, multilingual, math, and code benchmarks, ahead of models trained on 4 to 6

translated_title: Lara Mini Base：语言多样性是资源，而非权衡
translated_abstract: 通用语言模型主要以英语进行训练：在我们所调研的开放模型中，非英语预训练数据占比最多仅有12%。为欧洲语言构建的模型虽然给这些语言提供了多得多的数据，但其性能却远低于同规模的通用模型。一个普遍的担忧是，在小模型中，各种语言会争夺模型容量。我们提出了Lara Mini base，这是一个从零开始在6万亿token上训练的模型，涵盖英语及其他44种语言，合计覆盖欧盟全部24种官方语言。随着训练的推进，这44种非英语语言合计的数据量逐渐超过了英语。为了让这些语言以低成本获得足够的容量，Lara Mini base采用了混合专家（MoE）架构，总参数量为72亿，激活参数量为6亿。在激活参数量不超过20亿的开放基础模型中，它在标准英语、多语言、数学和代码等基准测试中取得了最高的平均分，领先于使用4至6万亿（此处原文似乎被截断）数据训练的模型。
tldr: Lara Mini Base是一个采用混合专家架构（总参数7.2B、激活参数0.6B）的多语言基础模型，在覆盖欧盟全部24种官方语言的45种语言上从零训练，证明语言多样性可以作为资源而非权衡，并在同规模开放基础模型中取得英语、多语言、数学和代码基准的最佳平均成绩。
en_tdlr: Lara Mini Base is a mixture-of-experts foundation model (7.2B total, 0.6B active parameters) trained from scratch on 45 languages covering all 24 official EU languages, showing that language diversity can serve as a resource rather than a trade-off and achieving the highest average scores among comparable open base models on English, multilingual, math, and code benchmarks.
